notes.title: Game update on February 5th, 2025
January 2025 game version update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, here are the details of this update:

1:The game now includes a clothing damage system. Each character has detailed clothing damage effects. As the game progresses, their outfits will gradually show wear and tear.

2:Added a “Survivor Mode,” which mimics the gameplay of Vampire Survivors. It features infinite wave challenges, and after each wave, you can choose an option to enhance your character.

3:I have made extensive adjustments to the in-game numerical system to reduce monotony and highlight challenges.

4:Introduced a talent enhancement system. You can use enhancement points to purchase upgrades, strengthening or altering various aspects of characters. You can improve attack power, support functions, and various auxiliary adjustments through this system.

5:Updated and adjusted the outfits of five game characters, enhancing texture while adapting to changes brought by the clothing damage system.

6:Replaced background music from the previous version that might have had copyright issues.

Welcome to experience the new content in the game, and I will continue to keep the game updated. Thank you.
